assessment.summary: Adopting the National Energy Retail Law replaced a state retailer licence with one national authorisation and common customer rules. It lowers the cost for a retailer of serving customers in several states.

marks.reason: One national retailer authorisation and common customer protections replace state regimes.
Retailers operating in several states comply with one framework instead of several.
